data.description:
## Incident Overview

LLM review findings frequently lack the `relation` field. The novelty gate treats these as `NEW_INTRODUCED`, then downgrades them as 'unjustified NEW_INTRODUCED outside prior defense window.' Despite being downgraded, these findings still block the merge at 'important' severity. On integration review passes where `DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES=true`, the findings cannot be defended against — the defense mechanism is suppressed. The only escape is admin bypass.

**Observed on**: PRs #364, #368, #371
**Expected**: Findings without a relation field should either (a) have a relation field populated by the reviewer, or (b) be handled gracefully by the novelty gate rather than creating unresolvable blocks.
**Actual**: Missing relation -> NEW_INTRODUCED assumption -> novelty gate downgrade -> still blocks -> no defense path -> admin bypass required
data.title: ci-llm-review: findings missing relation field -> novelty gate blocks merge with undefendable downgrades
